title: Voice AI + Builder Prime: How the Integration Works
summary: See how Leaping AI works inside Builder Prime: checking every sales rep’s calendar, creating contacts and opportunities, and booking appointments.
body_markdown:
By Muhammad Nael Syed, Content Writer at Leaping AI


“Thursday afternoon works for me. Do you have anyone available?”


A simple question from a homeowner, but not always such a simple answer.


For home improvement call centers, booking an appointment isn't always as easy as picking an open slot. Someone needs to check the schedule, collect the homeowner's details, and make sure the appointment ends up in the right place. Leaping AI works with Builder Prime to check your sales team's availability and book appointments during the call. But there's an interesting detail in how it handles those calendars, especially when you have several reps taking estimates.


## Why Builder Prime's Calendar Setup Matters


Builder Prime is built for home improvement contractors, including remodeling, roofing, and window and door companies. Unlike a CRM focused mainly on lead management, it also brings estimates, production management, payments, and reports into the same platform.


That makes the first appointment an important starting point. It's where a homeowner's inquiry begins moving toward an actual project.


But there's a scheduling challenge. Builder Prime's API lets Leaping AI check one sales rep's calendar at a time. If your company has several reps handling estimates, checking just one calendar won't show all the available options.


Leaping AI handles this by checking each rep's calendar through its own function and combining the open slots. The homeowner can then choose from the available times without your CSR having to check each schedule manually.


## How Leaping AI Connects with Builder Prime


Leaping AI connects directly to Builder Prime's application programming interface (API), a way for two software systems to exchange information.


For contacts and appointments, Leaping AI communicates directly with Builder Prime. The calendar availability check works a little differently: Leaping AI uses a function it builds and hosts itself to gather open slots across sales reps. There's no third-party connector like Zapier required between the voice agent and Builder Prime.


Here's what happens during a call:


1.


**Check availability.** The agent checks individual sales reps' calendars and brings their open slots together.


2.


**Create the contact.** Leaping AI creates the homeowner's contact record in Builder Prime, which also opens an opportunity.


3.


**Book the appointment.** Once the homeowner chooses a time, the agent saves the appointment through Builder Prime's API.


4.


**Hand off the assignment.** The appointment initially goes onto a placeholder rep's calendar. Your team then reassigns it to the appropriate sales rep.


The integration handles the booking, but your team still makes the final sales rep assignment.


Contact details and appointments are written during the conversation, rather than waiting for someone to enter them afterward. The agent also waits until Builder Prime has saved the appointment before confirming it with the homeowner.


## What Happens After the Appointment Is Booked


An appointment is where the real sales work begins for a home improvement company. It’s the beginning of a relationship with a homeowner, rather than the end of an operational process.


Depending on how your Builder Prime statuses are set up, saving the appointment can move the lead to its next stage automatically, giving that admin time back to your team. From there, sales can track the appointment, prepare an estimate, and eventually move the job through the rest of the sales process.


Your team still handles the estimate and installation in Builder Prime. For leads that don’t book on the first call, Leaping AI’s[Campaigns](https://leapingai.com/blog/multi-channel-outreach-campaigns-for-home-remodelers) can follow up by phone and text on a schedule you set.


If you're reviewing your wider setup, our[guide to the home improvement tech stack](https://leapingai.com/blog/voice-ai-crm-integration) explains how voice AI, CRMs, and calendars fit together.
